sloka: देवतार्चाः प्रविद्धाश्च यज्ञ्गोष्ठ्यस्तथाविधाः ।माल्यापणेषु राजन्ते नाद्य पण्यानि वा तथा ॥२-७१-४१॥
transliteration: devatārcāḥ praviddhāśca yajñgoṣṭhyastathāvidhāḥ ।mālyāpaṇeṣu rājante nādya paṇyāni vā tathā ॥2-71-41॥

translations.english: ﻿ The offerings to deities have been dispensed with. There are no groups of people performing the usual holy sacrifices. The markets where garlands were sold now stand without them.
